title.es: Aquel en el que Fina quiere volver a casa
title.en: The One Where Fina Wants to Come Home

description.es: Marta se desahoga con Digna. Dice que cree que el motivo de la actitud de Fina hacia ella es que la culpa. Digna le dice a Marta que le dé algo de tiempo a Fina. Digna le dice a Fina que Marta se está culpando y que debería decirle la verdad. Esa noche, Marta visita a Fina, y hablan. Fina le toma la mano a Marta, dice que quiere volver a su casa, y se abrazan.
description.en: Marta confides in Digna. She says she thinks the reason for Fina's behavior toward her is that Fina blames her. Digna tells Marta to give Fina some time. Digna tells Fina that Marta is blaming herself and that she should tell her the truth. That evening, Marta visits Fina, and they talk. Fina takes Marta's hand, says she wants to return to their home, and they hug.
